## LocationService

The platform's regions and zones, and which services each zone offers.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `LocationClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `locationv1beta1.NewLocationClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new LocationClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetRegion` (`GetRegionRequest`) | `get_region` | `GetRegion` | `getRegion` | Returns a region. requires `name` |
| `ListRegions` (`ListRegionsRequest`) | `list_regions` | `ListRegions` | `listRegions` | Lists every region that has a zone, in catalog order. |
| `GetZone` (`GetZoneRequest`) | `get_zone` | `GetZone` | `getZone` | Returns a zone. requires `name` |
| `ListZones` (`ListZonesRequest`) | `list_zones` | `ListZones` | `listZones` | Lists every zone, in catalog order. |

Field names: Rust uses the proto names (`size_gib`), Go protoc-gen-go's (`SizeGib`), TypeScript the JSON names (`sizeGib`).

## Resources

### Region

A geographic area of the platform, made up of zones.

- Full name: `//location.origincloudapis.eu/regions/{region}`
- `name`: `regions/{region}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The region's resource name, `regions/eu-central1`. |
| `zones` | repeated string | output only | The region's zones, `zones/{zone}`, in catalog order. Names a `Zone`. |
| `displayName` | string | output only | The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1`. |

### Zone

A part of a region whose failures are independent of its other zones'.

- Full name: `//location.origincloudapis.eu/zones/{zone}`
- `name`: `zones/{zone}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The zone's resource name, `zones/eu-central1-az1`. |
| `region` | string | output only | The region the zone is in, `regions/{region}`. Names a `Region`. |
| `services` | repeated string | output only | The services whose zonal resources the zone holds, by the name of their API, such as `pvs`: the host `{service}.origincloudapis.eu` serves them. |
| `displayName` | string | output only | The name the console shows, such as `EU Central 1, zone 1`. |
